page.text:
A relation $R$ on $X$ is *symmetric* when the direction of relatedness is
bidirectional: $x \mathrel{R} y \implies y \mathrel{R} x$. In relational
algebra, symmetry is equivalent to the identity $R = R^{-1}$.
